title: Deliverable package manifest (per-project)
description: The top-level index of upload-ready deliverables assembled at PACKAGE, one file per project at packages/package-manifest.json. Lists every per-language package and its deliverables with content-addressed hashes. `distributable` snapshots whether rights were cleared at build time; the framework NEVER publishes — this manifest describes packages that a human may distribute once rights allow. Nothing here implies external upload.

source.description: Provenance snapshot (source url/title/channel) for the package README.

rights_status.description: rights_status at build time (e.g. unreviewed, self-authored, licensed, fair-use-claimed, do-not-distribute).

distributable.description: True iff rights_status was a distributable value when the package was built. False packages carry a NOT-cleared banner.

packages.description: One entry per active language track.

selection.description: Present when the project processed a source selection (not the whole video). Describes how the selected windows were assembled into this package's deliverables.

join_clips.description: true => clips were concatenated into one joined video; false => one deliverable per clip.

clips.description: One entry per selected window, in output (list) order.

type.description: Deliverable kind: dubbed-video, clip-video, joined-video, captions-srt, captions-vtt, readme.

clip_index.description: For per-clip deliverables (join_clips=false): which selected window this file belongs to.
